blocks.text: The prompt allowlist for AI Guard allows you to track and manage any prompts that you wish to allow that may otherwise be blocked by an existing AI Guard policy. Prompts sent to the allowlist endpoint are fully encrypted, so the prompt content remains protected end-to-end.
The prompt allowlist functionality is only available in Proxy mode.

blocks.heading: Configure AI Guard to Enable Allowlist

blocks.text: The following instructions explain what tenant settings you need to enable in AI Guard so that the prompt allowlist functionality is enabled.

blocks.item: From the AI Security Admin Portal left-side navigation, go to AI Guard > Tenant Settings.
On the Tenant Settings page, go to the Security tab.
Under Security Settings, enable Store Prompts/Responses and Enable Data Sharing for AI Training.
See image.

blocks.text: Using the allowlist functionality requires the System Administrator role with all-write access. Individual actions are governed by the Default Access permission. The following steps will explain how to add those permissions with role-based acces control (RBAC).

blocks.item: From the AI Security Admin Portal left-side navigation, go to AI Guard > RBAC Management.
Click Add Role to create a new role with allowlist access, or click Edit to add access to an existing role.
See image.
In the Add or Edit Role window, enable the following permissions as needed:
View allowlisted prompts: Default Access: View
Add to allowlist: Default Access: Create
Delete prompt from allowlist: Default Access: Delete
See image.
Click Create or Save when done.

blocks.text: To learn more about the Tenant Settings and RBAC Management pages, see Managing Tenant Settings and Managing Role-Based Access Control in AI Guard.
The following instructions explain how to add a blocked prompt to the allowlist.

blocks.item: From the AI Security Admin Portal left-side navigation, go to AI Guard > Dashboard.
Find the blocked prompt and click Details. The Transaction Details window opens.
See image.
At the bottom of the Transaction Details window under Prompt Details, click Reveal Prompt.
If the blocked prompt is the one you want to add to the allowlist, click Add to Allowlist.
See image.
In the Add to Allowlist window, confirm the prompt and click OK.
See image.
From the AI Security Admin Portal left-side navigation, go to AI Guard > Prompt Allowlist.
On the Prompt Allowlist page, you can find the prompts that you have added.
See image.

blocks.text: The following instructions explain how to delete a prompt from the allowlist.

blocks.item: From the AI Security Admin Portal left-side navigation, go to AI Guard > Prompt Allowlist.
On the Prompt Allowlist page, find the prompt you want to delete and in the Action column, click Delete.
See image.
In the Remove from Allowlist window, click OK.
See image.
